user_query: trass gmail with term mgm and avask from last 2 days

intent.goal: search gmail content for messages containing mgm and avask

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass'
AND u.database_name LIKE '%gmail%'
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-2 days')
AND (
  g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' 
  OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR g.subject LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%' 
  OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.sender_email LIKE '%avask%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;

Tel :   (852) 2545 0375 Fax :  (852) 2541 0362   From: Fionn Ng Sent: Friday, October 3, 2025 6:27 PM To: Koii Benvenutto <koii@trassgames.com> Cc: jayshay <jayshay@trassgames.com>; John Chiu <johnchiu@mgmproduction.com.hk>; Steve Shockey <steve@trassgames.com> Subject: RE: BATCH 2025-07 UK SHIPMENT ETA SHIPBOB WAREHOUSE ON SEPT 5 2025   Dear Koii,   We are still working hard on sourcing an alternative warehouse at the lowest possible rate and aim to finalize this by Monday, October 6, or Tuesday, October 7 at the latest . In the meantime, please kindly continue coordinating with ShipBob for storage, as this remains the best solution to avoid additional costs. It is important for us to understand their concerns regarding storage without a VAT number.   Regarding the email communication, I had assumed that both numbers would be ready before the shipment ETA, so I did not follow up with you earlier. Moving forward, I will make sure to follow up more thoroughly based on the lessons learned from this case. Thank you very much for your understanding.   We expect to have more updates by next Monday . Thank you again for your support.   Notes: We will require the “ShipBob sticker” for this lot, regardless of where the temporary storage takes place. Please arrange accordingly.   Thank you and wishing you a pleasant weekend.   Thanks with best regards Fionn Ng ******************************* MGM Industries & Co. Tel :   (852) 2545 0375 Fax :  (852) 2541 0362   From: Koii Benvenutto < koii@trassgames.com > Sent: Friday, October 3, 2025 5:23 AM To: Fionn Ng < fionnng@mgmproduction.com.hk > Cc: jayshay < jayshay@trassgames.com >; John Chiu < johnchiu@mgmproduction.com.hk >; Steve Shockey < steve@trassgames.com > Subject: Re: BATCH 2025-07 UK SHIPMENT ETA SHIPBOB WAREHOUSE ON SEPT 5 2025   Dear Fionn, Thank you for the quick reply and for having John work on a solution. We recognize the extra effort that this has caused for your team and we thank you both for working with us to find a solution. Let's align on the past communication and next steps. Communication & Shared Learnings Looking back at the July emails, there was actually a communication gap on both sides. July 21st , you stated "we will advise you on the storage costs" if we were unable to access the shipbob UK FC “storage only”. July 29th , I confirmed ShipBob denied UK access, which triggered the path in which we indeed needed to utilize one of Alina's facilities. July 30th , I confirmed we'd need storage for "less than a month" (our best estimate at the time) July 31st , you provided us with an update that you “coordinated with Alina regarding this issue, and she [could] assist in arranging temporary storage in the UK”. And you asked us to “provide an estimated duration" This is where the communication breakdown occurred. I failed to follow up with the dates and I apologize for that. I’m taking note of this moving forward. However, this is a significant piece of the logistics puzzle, especially considering the pricing. As with our other communications, when something goes unaddressed we’ve both been diligent about not letting the thread drop. We gave no explicit indication that we did not want to move forward with arranging storage with Alina. This is something that should not fall through the cracks due to one missed email. We're talking about a significant charge that was foreseeable, especially since we can only provide estimates for registration timelines based on what our tax agents tell us. In summary, this is a mutual learning opportunity for clearer communication going forward. VAT/EORI Timeline Our latest estimate from our uk agent AVASK is that we should receive the confirmation letter by the "end of October." There is no firm date, and it is coming via physical mail, so we cannot guarantee it will arrive by October 24. Our best guess is that we will be set to move the goods to ShipBob’s facility in the first week of November. Next Steps Please confirm: Once goods clear customs between Oct 5-8, is the plan to transport them directly to the new, more affordable facility John is sourcing? We want to ensure we can bypass the current expensive warehouse entirely. We look forward to the update on the alternative warehouse tomorrow. Best, Koii     Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com
